email.subject: Anchor Works: two quick fixes, likely costing calls
email.body:
Hi Sam,

Took a quick look at Anchor Works Plumbing's site. Two things stood out: there's no click-to-call button, so mobile visitors with a leaking pipe have to manually dial instead of tapping once - that's a real drop-off for emergency plumbing searches. And your hours aren't listed anywhere, so people can't tell if you're open right now and often just call the next result.

I also noticed no customer reviews on the page and a page title that doesn't say "plumber" or "Harbor Falls," which hurts how you show up in search.

I fix these for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough of what's costing you the most?

Alex
